visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 portable views. The complete temple/church exterior includes six front columns and two returns behind each end, smooth shafts with selected repair/rope grooves, tiered bases, simplified Corinthian capitals, open U-shaped entablature, recessed two-line dedication, grey podium and descending brick stair treads. The later church has the raised closed doorway with curved canopy, pilasters, framed upper window, split curved pediment and cross. Both side walls, inclined buttresses and the complete tiled nave roof are included. The missing antique porch roof and full antique pediment remain absent. Early renders prompted correcting the doorway canopy and stair material. Fine carving, stone joints and exact damage remain medium-fi estimates.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 shared-material views. Six common 256-square graphs provide marble, weathered limestone, long-format brick, ceramic roof tile, window grid and cast bronze through metric UVs and linear tints. Each graph is read once across the model; eviction releases geometry. Six near draws and one skyline draw. No embedded images, unique atlas or copied photograph. The shared marble approximates cipollino, brick and roof colors remain approximate, and the window-grid graph is a generic glazing treatment. Dark shared body-stone backs provide contrast behind the recessed dedication. Flat-stage views expose some buried retaining depth; terrain contact was inspected separately on the original standard DEM.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 medium-fi views: street/block/skyline at noon and late afternoon in Economy/High, an untextured silhouette, six architectural details, all four whole-building levels and transitions. Levels 535/2674/6110/12412 triangles retain the ten columns, open porch, complete church body, roof and characteristic split pediment. Skyline uses a simple stair ramp and coarse columns; district adds steps, bases, coarse capitals, buttresses and facade trim; street adds more profiles and canopy geometry; closeup adds recessed dedication letters, Corinthian leaf/volute masses and selected shaft grooves. Initial skyline plus district geometry totals 317136 bytes, plus six reused common graphs. Separate attribute streams avoid duplicate GPU uploads. Physical-device and dense-city measurements remain pending.

An ordinary article describes eight columns, while the inspected front/west pictures support the modeled return arrangement; this discrepancy remains explicit. Geometry uses raw east/south coordinates at heading 0, with an internal 33.1047-degree rotation and local +Z facing southwest.
